agent: propose the next bounded step in the project journal

nextActions.distinction: mechanical actions are what the scheduler/product can legally execute next; decisionRelevant items are advisory judgements about what may advance the project, not authority, acceptance or a promise of value

authorityBoundaries: The agent may investigate, propose and write only within its Work scope. It may not accept a source, approve its own proposal, promote a result, or change the goal or a binding requirement.
Accepting a result is an operator action through the existing promotion path.
Source intake: only an independent operator can accept external source bytes.
Operator intent admission: not composed; an intent apply will refuse rather than self-authorize.

workers.detail: no worker transport is composed in this deployment; only canonical attempt state is observable
